stream: dataset / Lexibank / Peiros v1.1 cardinality correction and provenance audit
purpose: Correct a connector-representation double count before audited release and preserve a traceable explanation without promoting lexical content.

correction.error_mechanism: The GitHub connector response contains the decoded CSV twice: once in top-level content and once in structuredContent.content. A resource-wide text search therefore returned 202 hits. Restricting the search to the first decoded CSV representation, ending before structuredContent begins, returns 101 Mundari row hits.

rights_and_cultural_boundary.note: This correction concerns cardinality and provenance integrity only. No lexical values, participant-derived content, or cultural propositions are promoted by this audit.

deduplication.reason_count_neutral: The correction changes neither the controlled source identity count nor publication evidence counts.

promotion.level: audit correction: connector-level duplicate representation separated from distinct CSV-row cardinality
